name: Sudan
value: RSF drone campaign; Amiet market strike toll
summary: RSF drone campaign on fuel and power continues; a reported 153–226 died in a 19 Oct army strike on Amiet market
state: A Sudanese army strike on Amiet market north of Abyei on 19 Oct reportedly killed 153 to 226 people, and the RSF has run a drone campaign against fuel and power sites since 22 Oct, with 21 sets of strikes recorded by 5 Nov (Critical Threats). Darfur 24 reported on 6 Nov that an RSF drone hit a South Kordofan fuel station, with local sources saying more than 19 died. Sudan accused Ethiopia at the UN on 1 Nov of allowing RSF drone launches, and both closed consulates from 4 Nov.
for_you: Civilians in Kordofan, Darfur, Blue Nile and cities that rely on the grid are most exposed. Loss of fuel and power tends to cut water, health care and food supply. FCDO travel advice and UN OCHA updates are the official references.
rubric_hit: Alert: massacres reported, including a reported 153–226 killed at Amiet market on 19 Oct, alongside sustained drone strikes on civilian infrastructure.
